faq.q: Who is Raul Bautista in GTA 6?

faq.q: Is Raul Bautista reckless in GTA 6?
faq.a: Rockstar directly calls him reckless, noting that the stakes increase as each score becomes more ambitious, alongside his confidence and charm.
